svg.title: Accelerator EUV concepts
svg.desc: Three lanes: a storage ring feeds a bending magnet or an undulator whose sinc-squared line and coherent fraction set a coherent-core pupil; a 100 TW laser drives a wakefield bunch that lases in an undulator only if its energy spread is below rho; a keV electron skims a grating (Smith-Purcell).
svg.text: how the light is made → the illuminator pupil
